privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.section1Title: 1. Who We Are and What We Do
privacyPage.section1Desc: Pstream is a link aggregator and search engine for publicly available embedded media. We do not host, upload, store, or control any video content on our servers. All media streams are sourced from independent third-party hosts and embedded via publicly available links. By using Pstream, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
privacyPage.section2Desc: We collect the minimum data necessary to operate the service:
privacyPage.s2L1: <0>Account Information:</0> Your email address and display name when you create an account via our authentication provider (Supabase Auth).
privacyPage.s2L2: <0>Profile Data:</0> Names, avatars, and preferences for any profiles created under your account.
privacyPage.s2L3: <0>Usage Data:</0> Watch history, continue-watching progress, and My List entries — stored exclusively in your authenticated account and never shared.
privacyPage.section3Desc: We are committed to protecting your privacy. We explicitly do not:
privacyPage.s3L1: <0>Log IP Addresses:</0> We do not log, store, or process your IP address in any persistent form.
privacyPage.s3L2: <0>Use Tracking Cookies:</0> We do not deploy any advertising, analytics, or cross-site tracking cookies.
privacyPage.s3L3: <0>Sell Your Data:</0> We do not sell, rent, or trade any personal data to third parties, ever.
privacyPage.s3L4: <0>Fingerprint Your Browser:</0> We do not perform browser fingerprinting or any form of device identification.
privacyPage.section4Desc: Under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the lawful bases we rely on for processing this information are:
privacyPage.s4L1: <0>Contractual Necessity:</0> To provide you with the link aggregation and profile features you signed up for.
privacyPage.s4L2: <0>Legitimate Interests:</0> To analyse general platform usage and improve performance, using strictly anonymised, aggregated data only.
privacyPage.section5Desc: Your data is securely stored using Supabase (our backend infrastructure provider). We use Row-Level Security (RLS) policies to ensure your watch history and profile data are strictly isolated and only accessible by your authenticated account. Supabase operates data centres in compliance with applicable data protection standards.
privacyPage.section6Desc: We use third-party APIs including TMDB (for metadata) and Cloudflare Turnstile (for bot protection). These services operate under their own independent privacy policies. We proxy sensitive API requests through our backend to minimise client-side data exposure. Pstream does not share identifiable user data with these services.
privacyPage.section7Desc: Under UK GDPR, you have the following rights:
privacyPage.s7L1: <0>Right of Access:</0> Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPage.s7L2: <0>Right to Erasure:</0> Request deletion of your personal data (the "Right to be Forgotten"). You can delete your account and all associated data directly from the Settings page at any time.
privacyPage.s7L3: <0>Right to Rectification:</0> Request correction of any inaccurate personal data we hold.
privacyPage.s7L4: <0>Right to Object:</0> Object to processing of your personal data where we rely on legitimate interests.
privacyPage.section8Desc: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your data rights, please contact the repository maintainers via the Contact page or the email address listed therein.

dmcaPage.title: DMCA Safe Harbor Notice
dmcaPage.section1Title: 1. Our Role — Link Aggregator, Not a Host
dmcaPage.section1Desc: Pstream is a link aggregator and search engine. We do not host, upload, store, transmit, or control any video or media content on our own servers. All video streams referenced by this service are embedded from independent third-party hosting services over which Pstream has no control. Pstream operates exclusively as a search index of publicly available embedded links, in a manner consistent with the safe harbour provisions of 17 U.S.C. § 512(d) of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).
dmcaPage.section2Desc: If you are a copyright owner, or an agent authorised to act on behalf of a copyright owner, and you believe that a link indexed by Pstream points to material that infringes your copyright, you may submit a written DMCA takedown notice. To be effective under 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3), your notice must include all of the following elements:
dmcaPage.s2L1: <0>Physical or electronic signature</0> of the copyright owner or their authorised agent.
dmcaPage.s2L2: <0>Identification of the copyrighted work</0> you claim has been infringed, or if multiple works are covered by a single notice, a representative list of such works.
dmcaPage.s2L3: <0>Identification of the material</0> (i.e. the specific Pstream link or URL) that you claim is infringing, with sufficient detail to allow us to locate it in our index.
dmcaPage.section3Desc: Your DMCA notice must also include:
dmcaPage.s3L1: <0>Your contact information</0> — name, address, telephone number, and email address.
dmcaPage.s3L2: <0>A statement of good faith</0> — that you have a good faith belief that the use of the material in the manner complained of is not authorised by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
dmcaPage.s3L3: <0>A statement of accuracy</0> — that the information in the notice is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you are the copyright owner or authorised to act on their behalf.
dmcaPage.s3L5: We will review all notices and remove links from our index that satisfy the above statutory requirements.
dmcaPage.s3L6: <0>Counter-Notification:</0> If you believe your link was removed in error, you may submit a counter-notification under 17 U.S.C. § 512(g) to the same address.
dmcaPage.section4Title: 4. Important Limitation — We Can Only Remove Links
dmcaPage.section4Desc: Because Pstream does not host any media files, we are only able to remove the link from our search index. We cannot remove, delete, or take down the underlying video or media file itself — that content is stored on independent third-party servers entirely outside our control. To have the actual media file removed, you must contact the operator of the third-party hosting service directly. We strongly encourage copyright holders to contact the actual host of the infringing content, as that is the only party with the technical ability to remove it.
dmcaPage.section5Desc: In appropriate circumstances, and at our sole discretion, Pstream will disable or terminate access for users or accounts that are the subject of repeated valid infringement claims, consistent with our obligations under 17 U.S.C. § 512(i).
dmcaPage.section6Desc: Removal of a link from our index in response to a DMCA notice does not constitute an admission by Pstream that any infringement has occurred, nor does it constitute a waiver of any legal rights or defences.
